exposure: repeat C-section before onset of labor
repeat C-section after onset of labor
cohort: The study included 191 patients undergoing a third C-section.
finding: No significant differences were found in the occurrence of maternal complications or severe acute morbidity between the two groups, except for a higher rate of incomplete uterine rupture in the group undergoing C-section after the onset of labor.
mod_finding: Undergoing a third C-section after the start of labor has no relevant or adverse impact on overall maternal outcome, despite a higher rate of uterine dehiscence, which was not associated with other severe acute maternal morbidities.
